acceptable_paraphrases: The last digit of square numbers is one of the following: 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9
When squaring an integer, the result can end with these digits only: 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9
The final digit of perfect squares will be one of 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9
critical_errors: mistakenly stating that square numbers can end in 2
stating that all digits are possible last digits for square numbers
misconceptions: believing that other digits can be the last digit of a square number
thinking that all single-digit numbers can be the last digit of a square number
grading_notes: Points should be awarded based on inclusion of required concepts, correctness in critical errors, and presence of strict keywords. Acceptable paraphrases are worth partial credit.
